summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for AI data-center thermal management with a two-lane funnel. Vertiv is retained as the high-attention reference anchor because it has explicit NVIDIA AI-factory power/cooling context. The discovery lane surfaces Modine, AAON, and nVent as less obvious thermal-management beneficiaries: Modine through Airedale data-center cooling orders and CDU/control products; AAON through BASX-branded data-center cooling growth and backlog; and nVent through coolant distribution units, manifolds, rack-level cooling, PDUs, and service programs. This pass found few clean USD 300M-10B pure plays; the best evidence-backed names are mostly just above that range or larger, so size purity remains a coverage gap rather than a reason to force weaker micro-cap ideas.
